name: Arrow-Catching Shield

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +2 AC against ranged attacks; a Reaction makes you the target of a ranged attack aimed at someone within 5 ft.
text: Wield this Shield and you add +2 to your Armor Class whenever a ranged attack roll targets you, on top of the Shield's ordinary AC bonus. If someone within 5 feet of you is targeted by a ranged attack roll, you can spend your Reaction to become the target in their place.
